## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result and why it belongs in OfferLens.

## Verification

- [ ] Formatting, lint, strict types, unit tests, and production build pass
- [ ] Browser tests pass when the UI or APIs change
- [ ] Mobile, keyboard, reduced-motion, and print states were reviewed when relevant
- [ ] Tests and screenshots use only synthetic data

Commands and results:

## Trust review

- [ ] No secrets, raw personal data, debug logs, or fabricated live data
- [ ] Evidence/provenance remains connected to important claims
- [ ] Scoring/salary logic is deterministic and versioned if changed
- [ ] Protected traits and proxies do not enter decisions
- [ ] External AI remains explicitly consented
- [ ] Data-source URLs/licenses/limitations are documented if changed

## Screenshots / limitations

Include before/after visuals for UI work and disclose what could not be verified.
